eligible_path_definition: protocol-conformance results path_has_baseline_opportunity, i.e. at least 4 of 8 comparisons have 2-of-3 baseline opportunity
primary_intervention_comparison: fresh medoid selected by minimum h10 fresh-only mean pairwise distance versus uniform random fresh scout at identical four-branch compute budget
primary_detection_readout: mean across rollback steps of attempt0_outlier_ratio_O versus path_has_baseline_opportunity

bootstrap.unit: original role-pair path cluster including both rollback steps

within_job_null: condition on each eligible job's number of successful fresh branches and compute the exact Poisson-binomial upper tail for the internally selected medoid

prioritization_gate.meaning: only whether to spend new GPU budget; never a confirmatory method claim

multiplicity: h10 is primary; h5 and h20 are direction-only sensitivity checks
attempt0_rank_boundary: attempt0 rank is not evaluated as calibrated because its future participated in retrospective B/E selection
